fact_basis.fact: Model expected return 7.60% and volatility 10.00% for 60/40; stocks 16% volatility
fact_basis.source: page: workedExample / FAQ What return does the calculator assume

fact_basis.fact: Illustrative arithmetic: one standard deviation = 7.60% +/- 10.00% = about -2.4% to +17.6% (on $100,000: -$2,400 to +$17,600); two standard deviations = about -12.4% to +27.6% (-$12,400 on $100,000)
fact_basis.source: arithmetic from the page's own inputs; label as simple statistical rule of thumb, roughly two of three years within one SD, about 19 of 20 within two
